body:
TEST-ONLY synthetic fixture. Not ZoikoSuite fact.

# Plans
ZoikoSuite is offered in three plans: TEST_STARTER for small teams, TEST_GROWTH for growing finance teams, and an Enterprise plan for larger organisations that need single sign-on, multiple entities and custom terms.
# How pricing works
Prices depend on the market and billing term and are published on the pricing page; Enterprise pricing is agreed with the sales team.
# Trials
Trials of TEST_STARTER and TEST_GROWTH are offered only in markets where a trial is enabled. No payment details are collected in chat.
